A '''coraltree basal''' was the plinth from which [[Yorik-Kul]] surge coral slave seeds were harvested. When contact with a controlling [[dhuryam]] was lost, the slave seeds would drive the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] in which they were implanted to make contact with their parent basal, immobilizing the slaves.
